name: screenroom
description: Private screen sharing with per-application audio
//: Scripts only -- deliberately NOT an npm workspace. The three targets are genuinely different (browser+Node, Electron, Workers), and hoisting would make a Windows contributor install wrangler and a Linux contributor install Electron for no benefit.

scripts.test: npm run test:web && npm run test:desktop && npm run test:relay
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix screenroom install && npm --prefix screenroom-desktop install && npm --prefix screenroom-cloudflare install
